_comment: Single source of truth for the two databases this project talks to.
DB_TARGET picks one. Read by quant/shared/config.py (Python entry points)
so neither side can drift from the other.
Per field, 'env' lists the environment variables that override the default,
highest precedence first. That is how the same 'prod' entry works from a
laptop and from the EC2 host: the default port 5433 is the SSM tunnel, while
on EC2 the SSM-supplied QUANTDB_HOST/QUANTDB_PORT point straight at Aurora
on 5432. Setting QUANTDB_CONNINFO bypasses all of this with a literal DSN.

local.description: Laptop Postgres 17 on loopback, populated by ./scripts/dbctl.sh restore
local.notes: Password is not a secret: a throwaway database bound to loopback, rebuilt from a dump. Credentials come from .env, never SSM.

prod.description: Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2. From a laptop: SSM port-forward on 127.0.0.1:5433. On EC2: the cluster endpoint on 5432 via SSM.
prod.notes: No password default — it must come from SSM or .env. Never commit one here.
